import os

from pocket_coffea.utils.configurator import Configurator
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nObj_eq, get_nObj_min
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection
from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import passthrough
from pocket_coffea.parameters import defaults
from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessorABC

localdir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

default_parameters = defaults.get_default_parameters()
parameters = defaults.merge_parameters_from_files(
    default_parameters,
    update=True,
)

# --- Jet-multiplicity binning: exactly 4, exactly 5, >=6 "JetGood" jets ---
njet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Njet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"],
)

# --- B-tag-multiplicity binning: exactly 2, >=3 "BJetGood" jets ---
nbjet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Nbjet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"],
)

# --- Cartesian product of the two binnings: 3 x 2 = 6 categories ---
cartesian_categories = CartesianSelection(
    multicuts=[njet_multicut, nbjet_multicut],
)

cfg = Configurator(
    parameters=parameters,
    datasets={
        "jsons": [f"{localdir}/datasets/signal_samples.json"],

    },

)
